entities.summary: Reem Khamis is a German karateka. She has been part of the German National Team since the middle of the 2021 year. She won the gold medal in the women's kumite 61 kg event at the 2023 European Games held in Poland. She also won the gold medal in individual 61kg event at the 2023 European Karate Championships held in Guadalajara, Spain.
